description:
##About Me 
Hello, my name is Captain Nick. All I want is for you to have a great time. I spent the majority of my life on the water and Lake Michigan is my Happy Place. I would love to be your Captain so you could enjoy beautiful Lake Michigan as much as I do. Whether you are out celebrating with friends, taking a break from the hectic work week, or want to spend quality time with family, I will get you there and back in a fun and safe manner while making memories to last a lifetime.
I am a US Coast Guard licensed boat captain. I have over 40 years of power boating experience operating on the Great Lakes, Gulf Coast, and US Rivers.

Hope to see you soon!

##Hourly Rates:
$100 an hour
10% discount to Military and first responders.
 
Payments are accepted via Zelle, Venmo, Cash the day of the charter. 
No deposit required.

faqs:
##WHAT SHOULD I WEAR?
•	The weather on Lake Michigan is ever changing.  A wind breaker is often a good idea and in the early or late part of the sailing season an intermediate layer might be just the ticket to comfort.
•	Soft sole, non-marking shoes or sandals only. 
•	If conditions and time warrant, a swimsuit and a towel.
•	Sunglasses and a hat that you can keep attached to your head in windy conditions.

##WHAT SHOULD I BRING?
•	Sunscreen is a must! You may not think you need it, but even on a cloudy day those rays can get you.
•	Ice
•	Any food and or beverages you may desire.  Food already prepared is the way to go.  We often call it finger food.  Examples might be, appetizers, sandwiches, fruit & veggies, sushi, etc.. We have a refrigerator aboard.  Yes, you are welcome to bring wine, beer and or other alcoholic spirits aboard however due to insurance regulations we are not allowed to serve you.
•	If you have special concerns, please let your captain know in advance and we’ll do our best to accommodate your needs. 
•	Plates, stemware, and utensils for your use.

##IS IT CUSTOMARY TO TIP THE CAPTAIN AND CREW?
Yes, it is and it is based on the boat rental cost. and usually starts at 15%. If there is a crew then it is split equally between the captain and crew for services.

##PLEASE ARRIVE AT LEAST 30 MINS BEFORE YOUR TRIP IS SCHEDULED.
Why is this? So that everyone is there, get checked in make sure there is time if paperwork (waivers) if needed. We can load the and board the boat, get a brief safety talk. This way you can get the most out of your trip and enjoy more time.
